verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs show framework-integrated tracing for LangChain and LangGraph, including an OpenTelemetry/OpenInference path, and claim it works with major LLM providers and agentic frameworks. However, the evidence is mostly cookbook tutorials rather than integration reference docs, and there is no explicit OpenAI SDK wrapper or Vercel AI SDK integration. Missing for 10: explicit OpenAI SDK auto-instrumentation docs, any Vercel AI SDK integration evidence, a dedicated integrations reference describing the LangChain hook mechanism, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: A simple LangChain-powered AI Agent that uses OpenAI's language models and a custom tool, with all agent activities logged and monitored in Galileo.
Learn how to instrument a LangGraph agent with OpenTelemetry and OpenInference to capture detailed traces, spans, and metrics.
Galileo works with all major LLM providers and can be used with your favorite agentic framework
Stream LangGraph traces to **Galileo** for end-to-end observability
